hypothesis: The existing paper-safe risk policy can be materialized into explicit main- and small-account ledger constraints, and exact-time capacity collisions can be ordered with the existing causal candidate ranking, without fitting retrospective actions or changing scanner or Micro-v0.1 behavior.

materialization_contract.campaign_open_notional: minimum of starting buying power and 50% of starting equity
materialization_contract.total_open_notional: same as campaign cap because one open position is permitted
materialization_contract.starter_max_notional: same as campaign cap; no unsourced smaller starter fraction is invented
materialization_contract.slippage: recorded by the ledger; frozen execution approval remains authoritative

observations.title: I Reset My Account to $2,000 (AGAIN) Robinhood Challenge Ep 1
observations.observation: A specific challenge described one trade per day and a 10% daily max-risk/target. That aggressive challenge value is not adopted by the paper policy.

observations.title: Ultimate Guide to Trading in a Small Account
observations.observation: A beta-phase teaching exercise recommends one trade per day and concentrating buying power on the best setup; it is a training stage, not a universal current-account limit.

observations.title: Top 5 Reasons Why Traders Lose Money — Don’t Make These Mistakes!!!
observations.observation: The first trade is described as a starter used to test the market before greater aggression. No numerical starter fraction is stated.

observations.title: I Reset My Account to $2,000 (AGAIN) Charles Schwab ThinkorSwim Challenge Ep 1
observations.observation: The order-script example uses 50% of buying power but explicitly calls 25%, 75% or 80% adjustable and says the earlier cash-account one-trade convention changed. It cannot establish a stable Ross sizing constant.

observations.title: +100% Move then 3 Halts Down on Bad News! (Reminder: Market Closed Tomorrow)
observations.observation: The recap says attention priority moved back to the main account after the small account had previously been front and center. Cross-account dispatch priority is therefore not frozen as a universal rule.

prohibited_interpretations: The paper-safe values are project safeguards, not Ross-replication estimates.
The one-position and two-entry caps are conservative engineering translations, not transcript-authored constants.
Priority ordering is not a top-N scanner rule and does nothing when account capacity is not contested.
No historical portfolio replay or profitability result exists at registration.
promotion_gate: Integrate these exact policies with a newly preregistered label-blind chronological scanner, Micro, execution and ledger stream; freeze all account artifacts before opening retrospective actions or outcomes.
